div.div: أَرْخَى [as meaning More relaxing or slackening or loosening] is used in a verse of Hassán Ibn-Thábit for the regular expression أَشَدُّ إِرْخَآءً: it is like مَا أَحْوَجَهُ meaning مَا أَشَدَّ حَاجَتَهُ. (El- Hareeree's “ Durrat el-Ghowwás, ” in De Sacy's “ Anthol. Gramm. Ar, ” p. 52 of the Ar. text.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
